# Raval

> Raval is a free, open-source browser extension for measuring distances, inspecting sizes, fonts and colours, placing guides and annotating any webpage. It was called Calipers until October 2026.

Raval is a browser extension for designers and frontend developers who need pixel-perfect measurements directly on live web pages — without screenshots or switching to a separate app.

## What Raval does

- Inspect: hover any element for its size; click text or an element for its typography, colours, margin, padding, border and radius
- Measure: click up to five elements to read the pixel distance between them
- Guides: place horizontal and vertical guides that snap to element edges and are saved per page
- Annotate: mark up the page with size callouts, notes, arrows and freehand strokes
- Extract CSS custom properties as design tokens (JSON)
- Screenshot the page or a region, with your measurements and annotations on it
- Keyboard shortcuts for every action

## Who it's for

- Frontend developers doing QA before shipping UI
- Designers checking implementation against specs
- Agencies reviewing client websites for spacing and alignment
- Anyone who needs a pixel ruler inside the browser

## Install

- Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/raval/anocimjcbeijomifkdcdkafdjphcdale
- Website: https://raval.solomonakuson.com
- GitHub (open source, MIT): https://github.com/heysolomon/raval

## How it compares

| Tool | Platform | Approach |
|------|----------|----------|
| Raval | Chrome | Reads real values from the live page |
| PixelSnap | macOS desktop | Screenshot-based measurement |
| Page Ruler Redux | Chrome | Basic ruler overlay |
| Dimensions | Chrome | Hover dimensions only |

Raval combines inspecting, measuring, guides, annotation, design tokens and screenshots in one free, open-source extension that reads the page's real values.

## Keyboard shortcuts

- Alt+Shift+C (Option+Shift+C on Mac) — Open or close Raval
- 1 — Inspect
- 2 — Measure
- 3 — Guides
- 4 — Annotate
- R — Rulers on/off
- D — Design tokens
- S — Screenshot
- ? — Show all shortcuts
- Cmd/Ctrl+Z — Undo
- Esc — Close what is open, then Raval
